Babies (2010)

Runtime 79 minutes
Director Thomas Balmès
Genre Documentary

Babies follows four infants during their first year of life in four very different cultural contexts. Without narration or interviews, the film invites us to observe everyday moments of development and consider both the remarkable similarities and meaningful differences in children’s early experiences around the world.

Instructions

Watch like a researcher

As you watch Babies (2010), imagine you are observing the children for a developmental research study. Record what you can see and hear, not assumptions about what it means.

  • Notice behavior, setting, and interactions.
  • Write objective, specific field notes.
  • Compare development across contexts.

Bring your worksheet

01 - Watch & Observe

As you watch Babies (2010), imagine you are observing the children for a developmental research study. Your goal is to carefully record what you see, rather than evaluate or judge what is happening.
